recipe.title: Apple Cider Dijon Chicken Harvest Bowl
recipe.summary: Juicy sliced chicken with roasted potatoes, green beans, apples, and a warm apple-cider Dijon sauce.
recipe.story: This harvest bowl uses a modest amount of apple and cider for fall flavor while keeping chicken and roasted vegetables at the center of the meal.
recipe.serving_size: 4.5 ounces cooked chicken, 7 ounces roasted harvest mixture, and 2 tablespoons sauce
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless skinless chicken breasts, approximately 3 chicken breasts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F and the air fryer to 375°F.

Toss the potatoes and green beans with 1 teaspoon olive oil, half of the garlic powder, half of the onion powder, salt, and pepper. Spread on a sheet pan and roast for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring halfway.
During the final 8 minutes of roasting, add the diced apple to the sheet pan and toss with the vegetables.

Rub the whole chicken breasts with the remaining olive oil, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Air-fry for 10 to 14 minutes, turning halfway, until the thickest part reaches 165°F. Rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Combine the apple cider, Dijon mustard, sugar-free maple syrup, and apple cider vinegar in a small saucepan. Simmer for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until reduced to 1/2 cup total sauce.
Weigh the roasted potato, green bean, and apple mixture and divide it into four portions of 7 ounces each.
For each bowl, serve 7 ounces roasted harvest mixture with 4.5 ounces sliced cooked chicken and 2 tablespoons apple-cider Dijon sauce.
tips: Cook the chicken breasts whole and slice them only after resting.
Reduce the sauce to exactly 1/2 cup so each serving receives 2 tablespoons.
Add the apple near the end of roasting so it softens without turning into applesauce.
